faqs.label: Are these final MiniDev prices?
faqs.content: No. Prices on this frontend demonstration are placeholders and must be approved before launch.

faqs.label: Can I start without a credit card?
faqs.content: The demo trial flow does not request payment details and does not create a real account.

faqs.label: Can I change plans later?
faqs.content: The intended product model supports plan changes as a team grows. No billing backend exists in this demo.

faqs.label: Which apps are included?
faqs.content: Growth and Scale show all MiniDev apps. Starter demonstrates a two-app entry plan.

faqs.label: Is support included?
faqs.content: Community, email, and priority support levels are illustrative until the service offering is finalized.

faqs.label: What happens after the trial?
faqs.content: Nothing is provisioned in this frontend-only build. The flow exists to demonstrate the intended experience.
